If you can do that, try to head west. With that done, make an effort to travel south. With that done, make an attempt to head south. And then, head east. Then, head north. Next, make an effort to head west. After that, head north. Then, make an attempt to venture north. And then, travel north. Following that, move east. After that, try to venture south. And then, head west. If you can do that, attempt to take a trip south. Then, attempt to go south. Then, make an effort to take a trip south. With that over with, move south. Once you manage that, go to the south. After that, attempt to head east. Then, move south. With that accomplished, make an effort to venture west. And then, attempt to travel south. And then, go east. And then, attempt to head east. That done, attempt to move east. Next, pick up the coin from the floor of the attic. That's it!
